def process(beach_2020, beach_2021, beach_2022, beach_2023):
    import pandas as pd
    df = pd.concat([beach_2020, beach_2021, beach_2022, beach_2023], ignore_index=True)
    # standardize
    df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    df['Beach Type Description'] = df['Beach Type Description'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['Violation'] = df['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
    df['Sample Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Sample Date'], errors='coerce')
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
    df['month'] = df['Sample Date'].dt.month
    df['is_fresh'] = df['Beach Type Description'].str.upper().eq('FRESH')
    df['is_exceed'] = df['Violation'].isin(['YES','Y','TRUE','T'])
    # keep years
    return df[(df['Year']>=2020) & (df['Year']<=2023)]

operators.customDisplayName: Concatenate 2020-2023 water-body-testing tables; standardize columns, parse Sample Date, derive month, and flags for fresh beaches and exceedances; filter to years 2020-2023

def process(beach_all):
    import pandas as pd
    df = beach_all.copy()
    df = df[df['is_fresh']]
    # monthly exceedance rate
    g = df.groupby(['Year','month']).agg(
        n_samples=('is_exceed','size'),
        n_exceed=('is_exceed','sum')
    ).reset_index()
    g['exceed_rate'] = g['n_exceed'] / g['n_samples']
    return g.sort_values(['Year','month'])

operators.customDisplayName: For fresh water beaches only, compute monthly exceedance rate = #exceed / #samples by Year and month (2020-2023).

def process(precip_all) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    df = precip_all.copy()

    # Keep only rows where Year is a 4-digit year
    df['Year_str'] = df['Year'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df = df[df['Year_str'].str.fullmatch(r'\d{4}')].copy()
    df['Year'] = df['Year_str'].astype(int)

    month_cols = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec']

    # Convert month columns to numeric (coerce errors like traces, etc.)
    for c in month_cols:
        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors='coerce')

    # Long format by source, Year, month
    long = df.melt(id_vars=['source','Year'], value_vars=month_cols, var_name='month_name', value_name='rain')

    month_map = {'Jan':1,'Feb':2,'Mar':3,'Apr':4,'May':5,'Jun':6,'Jul':7,'Aug':8,'Sep':9,'Oct':10,'Nov':11,'Dec':12}
    long['month'] = long['month_name'].map(month_map).astype(int)

    # Average rainfall across stations for each Year-month
    out = long.groupby(['Year','month'], as_index=False).agg(rain=('rain','mean'))

    # Impute missing values with median of the month across non-missing years (within 2020-2023 window)
    out = out[(out['Year']>=2020) & (out['Year']<=2023)].copy()
    med = out.groupby('month')['rain'].median()
    out['rain'] = out.apply(lambda r: med.loc[r['month']] if pd.isna(r['rain']) else r['rain'], axis=1)

    return out.sort_values(['Year','month']).reset_index(drop=True)

def process(fresh_exceed_monthly):
    import pandas as pd

    years = [2020, 2021, 2022, 2023]
    months = list(range(1, 13))
    grid = pd.MultiIndex.from_product([years, months], names=['Year', 'month']).to_frame(index=False)

    df = fresh_exceed_monthly[['Year', 'month', 'exceed_rate']].copy()
    full = grid.merge(df, on=['Year', 'month'], how='left')

    # median per month across non-missing years
    month_median = full.groupby('month')['exceed_rate'].median()

    # fill missing with that month's median
    full['exceed_rate'] = full['exceed_rate'].fillna(full['month'].map(month_median))

    # if a month has no observations in any year, median will be NaN -> fill with 0
    full['exceed_rate'] = full['exceed_rate'].fillna(0.0)

    return full.sort_values(['Year', 'month']).reset_index(drop=True)

operators.customDisplayName: Create full Year-month grid (2020-2023, months 1-12) for fresh-beach exceedance rate; impute missing exceed_rate using the median exceed_rate for that month across non-missing years (2020-2023); any months with no data in all years filled with 0.

def process(precip_clean_monthly, fresh_exceed_imputed):
    import pandas as pd
    # annualize by averaging monthly values within each year
    rain_y = precip_clean_monthly.groupby('Year', as_index=False)['rain'].mean().rename(columns={'rain':'rain_mean'})
    exc_y = fresh_exceed_imputed.groupby('Year', as_index=False)['exceed_rate'].mean().rename(columns={'exceed_rate':'exceed_mean'})
    df = rain_y.merge(exc_y, on='Year', how='inner').sort_values('Year')

    # compute year-over-year direction (sign of delta)
    df['rain_diff'] = df['rain_mean'].diff()
    df['exc_diff'] = df['exceed_mean'].diff()
    df['same_direction'] = (df['rain_diff'].fillna(0).apply(lambda x: 0 if x==0 else (1 if x>0 else -1)) ==
                            df['exc_diff'].fillna(0).apply(lambda x: 0 if x==0 else (1 if x>0 else -1)))

    # ignore first year (no prior)
    all_same = bool(df.loc[df['Year']!=df['Year'].min(), 'same_direction'].all())

    # also provide correlation as supporting info
    corr = float(df['rain_mean'].corr(df['exceed_mean']))
    out = df.copy()
    out['corr_rain_exceed'] = corr
    out['trend_same_all_transitions'] = all_same
    return out

operators.customDisplayName: Aggregate to annual means (rain across months; exceedance rate across months after imputation). Compare year-over-year direction of change between rain and exceedance; also compute correlation.
